requirements.requirement: Request Fields Classification and Validation Semantics
requirements.observable_behavior: Request fields are KNOWN_FIELDS; original binary performs zero non-empty validation checks; defensive validation in clean-room code is an IMPLEMENTATION_CHOICE
requirements.notes: Disassembly executes no branch or comparison on request_id or command emptiness. ValidateAICommand() non-empty checks are DEFENSIVE_VALIDATION.

requirements.notes: ARM64: log string at 0x6d5f36; returns at 0x53f668. AMD64: log string at 0xb77ed7; returns at 0x9e336a.

requirements.notes: ARM64: logs at 0x6d86f2, calls 0x5f730 (runtime.newproc). AMD64: logs at 0xb7a693, calls 0x451c40 (runtime.newproc).

requirements.requirement: Clean-Room Safety Restriction - Execution Boundary Deferred
requirements.observable_behavior: Clean-room safe implementation must NOT implement, invoke, or expose command execution; zero os/exec, zero exec.Command, zero shell simulator
requirements.notes: Safe reconstructed code provides only schema, parser, and response serialization data structures. No execution logic allowed.

requirements.observable_behavior: Agent builds response map with request_id (string), exit_code (int), stdout (string), and stderr (string) and serializes via json.Marshal
requirements.notes: ARM64: keys at 0x6b3a5b, 0x6b1f17, 0x6ade37, 0x6ade3d; calls 0x1317c0. AMD64: keys at 0xb55aee, 0xb53f84, 0xb4fe64, 0xb4fe6a; calls 0x531b60.

requirements.observable_behavior: Worker copies incoming request.RequestID directly into response.request_id
requirements.notes: Dataflow verified in disassembly closure environment to response map key 'request_id'.

requirements.observable_behavior: Agent transmits response via (*DataChannel).Send([]byte), sending serialized JSON as BINARY_JSON_BYTES
requirements.notes: Disassembly invokes (*DataChannel).Send (ARM64: 0x49a3d0, AMD64: 0x9250c0), NOT SendText. Framing is strictly BINARY_JSON_BYTES.

requirements.observable_behavior: ordered=true is classified as REFERENCE_ONLY from frontend browser creation; Agent binary does not inspect ordered flag
requirements.notes: Corrects older erroneous classification of inbound ordered property as STATIC_CONFIRMED.

requirements.requirement: Channel Inertness in Clean-Room Agent Runtime
requirements.observable_behavior: ai-command-channel remains strictly inert in clean-room production runtime; no OnMessage business handler attached, no ADB bridge activation
requirements.notes: Parser existence does not equal channel activation. Channel must not be attached to any executor in production.
